samples.description: Full synthetic pump case (unchanged export of CASE-PUMP-001).

case.symptom_text: Pump start hone ke 20-25 min baad drive-end bearing housing ke paas ghurr-ghurr awaaz aati hai aur vibration badh jaati hai. Bearing side haath se (door se, safe hone par) normal se zyada garam lagti hai. Discharge pressure normal hai. Pichle mahine barish ke baad pump house me paani aaya tha.
case.symptom_structured: Progressive DE-bearing noise, vibration and temperature rise after ~20-25 min run; hydraulic performance normal; recent water/dust exposure of bearing housing.
case.operating_status: Running, normal duty point (illustrative; no recorded readings)
case.symptom_frequency: Continuous after warm-up; worsening over days (illustrative)
case.primary_suspected_cause: Grease contaminated by water/dust leading to spalling of DE bearing raceway (suspected, unconfirmed).
case.alternative_causes: Misalignment; over/under-greasing; cavitation; looseness; bearing housing seal failure.
case.failure_mechanism: Contaminant breaks lubricant film; metal-to-metal contact causes surface fatigue, spalling and rising friction heat.
case.differential_diagnosis: Misalignment: 2x running-speed and axial vibration; Cavitation: broadband high-frequency noise varying with suction conditions; Looseness: harmonics, phase differences; Seal failure: leakage visible. Diagnosis remains inconclusive if Tier 2 results lie within OEM/site baseline or point equally to two causes; then escalate to supervisor/OEM.
case.corrective_action_text: Isolate (LOTO), drain/depressurise, remove coupling guard and coupling, replace DE bearing set, inspect shaft journal/housing fits, clean housing, refill with OEM-specified lubricant, re-align, reinstall guard. Requires supervisor approval and LOTO before work. Tools/expertise: qualified maintenance technician with OEM procedure.
case.required_spares_text: Rolling element bearing set; bearing housing lip seals/isolators; lubricant per OEM; gaskets as required (part numbers/compatibility must come from OEM parts list)
case.post_repair_verification: Repeat the same Tier 2 measurements after repair; confirm original symptom absent; controlled restart under supervision; monitor for recurrence.
case.acceptance_criteria: Readings within OEM specification or approved site baseline (source: OEM manual / site standard - not stated in this workbook).
case.recurrence_prevention: Correct lubricant type/quantity; protect housing from water; condition monitoring (vibration, temperature); relubrication interval per OEM. Intervals: per OEM; none invented here.
case.early_warning: Rising temperature trend; high-frequency vibration; grease discolouration.
case.evidence_type: Engineering interpretation (no field record; no OEM manual consulted)
